source_lines: In this report, the term “TD Group” refers to TransDigm Group Incorporated, which holds all of the outstanding capital stock of TransDigm Inc. The terms “Company,” “TransDigm,” “we,” “us,” “our” and similar terms, unless the context otherwise requires, refer to TD Group, together with TransDigm Inc. and its wholly-owned and majority-owned subsidiaries for which it has a controlling interest. References to “fiscal year” mean the year ending or ended September 30. For example, “fiscal year 2024” or “fiscal 2024” means the period from October 1, 2023 to September 30, 2024.

acceptance_invariants: Every financial row retains a complete meaningful label and source position; no equal-vector-only joins.
All row amounts match the unchanged 95-row reference, with the eight CI rows independently read from PDF page 107.
All 21 printed dashes remain raw dashes and are represented as known zero; absence/missing is distinct.
Only physical PDF statements p105 BS, p106 IS, p107 CI and p109 CFS are in the expected census.
FY2024/23/22 durations use issuer fiscal policy dates; BS periods are instants with null starts.
Embedded common-stock share counts do not change the USD millions unit of its amount cells; treasury stock values retain negative sign.
EPS and per-common-share dividends use USD/share; weighted-average shares use million shares without currency.
Entity dimensions, ambiguous source grouping, note references, blank boundaries and non-provenanced citations do not silently compose.
The weighted-average shares heading on p106:32 is part of the full label for the p106:33 Basic and diluted values; its unit is million shares.

All 280 cells, including legacy 256 reference cells, must have explicit row_dimensions.quantity kind, scale, currency and unit-context citation in the new typed profile; legacy defaults do not qualify.
CI remains separate in the oracle and uses distinct CI row IDs/source locators; an explicit legacy IS enum alias may only carry the same one CI row, never duplicate it.
Currency-per-share and share quantities are reported only for their exact cited source period and cannot be aggregated or used in monetary accounting, identities or cash adjustments.

quantity_rules.cell_level: Every one of the 280 expected cells carries an explicit typed quantity; a missing descriptor is not a qualifying positive expectation.
quantity_rules.currency_rule: monetary and currency_per_share carry currency_code USD; shares carry no currency.
quantity_rules.nonmonetary_use: currency_per_share and shares are reported only for their exact cited source period. Do not add/subtract FY, YTD or LTM values. Do not use them in monetary accounts, identities or cash adjustments.
quantity_rules.legacy_compatibility: An absent descriptor on a legacy record retains its existing monetary wire behavior only; that default does not qualify the new 280-cell typed-profile proof.
quantity_rules.row_dimension_scope: Quantity dimensions are additive row_dimensions and do not replace or mutate the existing four-field judgments.
quantity_rules.CI_separation: CI stays the oracle statement kind with unique CI row IDs, source locators and periods. If the canonical statement-line enum lacks CI, an explicit legacy IS alias is allowed for transport only; it must not duplicate a CI row as an IS metric.
